scope: Approved coordination-model inventory for only A11/as-5 members 358, 353, 316, 319, 347 and 348. This is not a fabrication or as-built model.

change_visualisation.meaning: Display-only identification of this development change set. It does not describe steel paint, coating, material, construction status or source confidence.

IPE500.representation: Nominal rolled IPE profile with idealised profile geometry for coordination; rolling tolerances, camber and connection-specific modifications are excluded.

HEA200.representation: Nominal rolled HEA profile with idealised profile geometry for coordination; rolling tolerances, camber and connection-specific modifications are excluded.

IPE450.representation: Nominal rolled IPE profile with idealised profile geometry for coordination; rolling tolerances, camber and connection-specific modifications are excluded.

centreline_definitions_mm.method: Derived from the calibrated A11/as-5 local source projection: member centreline endpoints are midpoints of paired long outer-outline edges. The rafter outline paths are read directly from the A11 PDF with the Section_A11_Axis_5 calibration. The drawing traces determine member axes; text location is not used as geometry.
centreline_definitions_mm.section_orientation: A11/as-5 is a YZ elevation at the exact axis-5 station X=53750 mm. IPE500, HEA200 and IPE450 profile section height h is in the elevation plane; flange width b is out of plane along X. The 38.495 mm source-projected gap between IPE450 rafter ridge endpoints is preserved.

A11_05_358.derivation: Midpoints of A-side IPE500 outer outline edges in registered paths 1841/1842. Only the visibly labelled upper source segment is included; no lower continuation is inferred. Literal label 358 IPE500-S355JR is visually adjacent in AANZICHT as-5.

A11_05_353.derivation: Midpoints of E-side outer IPE500 contour edges in registered paths 1826/1827. Literal label 353 IPE500-S355JR is visually adjacent in AANZICHT as-5.

A11_05_316.derivation: Midpoints of B-side HEA200 outer contour edges in registered paths 1833/1834. Literal label 316 HEA200 is visually adjacent in AANZICHT as-5.

A11_05_319.derivation: Midpoints of C-side HEA200 outer contour edges in registered paths 1829/1830. Literal label 319 HEA200 is visually adjacent in AANZICHT as-5.

A11_05_347.derivation: Midpoints of the paired long A-side IPE450 roof outline edges in direct A11 PDF paths 1843/1844. Literal label 347 IPE450-S355JR is visually adjacent in AANZICHT as-5.

A11_05_348.derivation: Midpoints of the paired long E-side IPE450 roof outline edges in direct A11 PDF paths 1845/1846. Literal label 348 IPE450-S355JR is visually adjacent in AANZICHT as-5.

explicitly_not_inferred: No K200*100*4 member 374, connection, base plate, stiffener, secondary steel, mirrored member or unlabelled source contour is included.
The labelled IPE500 member 358 is limited to its source-projected upper segment; no continuation below Z=3615.000060 mm is inferred.
No fabrication definition or as-built claim is made.
